currentRoundInspection.method: Reference picture pixels inspected; standard viewer PMTiles used for approximate location, orientation and terrain fit.
currentRoundInspection.placement: The inspected aerial picture supports twin steep tiled roofs, elaborate stepped brick gables, copper-capped circular corner towers, separate gatehouse and bridges. Retained east/south mapped coordinates set approximate footprint and orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles supply coarse placement ground; reconstructed foundation and access paths are raised1m with toes extending below it, and the east bridge slopes toward its sampled shore endpoint. Actual lake waterline is supplied by host water data and is not surveyed here. Anchor 10.49020274,55.176204696; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 63.09605669230223m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.
